node.title: Re: Hash/Array slice : how to exclude items?
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
A while ago I [id://1224807|whipped up] [mod://Tie::Subset::Hash], and I took this oppertunity (and the inspiration from [Discipulus]'s [id://11149887|node]) to expand upon that with [mod://Tie::Subset::Hash::Masked]:

use Data::Dumper; use Tie::Subset::Hash::Masked; my @unwanted = qw/ schema log /; my %hash = ( schema=>1, log=>2, aa=>3 ); tie my %masked, 'Tie::Subset::Hash::Masked', \%hash, \@unwanted; print Dumper(\%masked); __END__ $VAR1 = { 'aa' => 3 };
